name: Palau
governmentType: presidential republic in free association with the US

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: although not expressly forbidden by law, Palau does not have political parties or coalitions

profile.religions: Roman Catholic 46.9%, Protestant 30.9% (Evangelical 24.6%, Seventh Day Adventist 5%, other Protestant 1.4%), Modekngei 5.1% (indigenous to Palau), Muslim 4.9%, other 12.3% (2020 est.)
profile.legalSystem: mixed system of civil, common, and customary law
profile.nationalHoliday: Constitution Day, 9 July (1981); Independence Day, 1 October (1994)
profile.location: Oceania, group of islands in the North Pacific Ocean, southeast of the Philippines
